lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters organized in a non-uniform grid, characterized by roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows across the visible lateral surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes that define a visible lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and lower intensity/shadowing on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-frequency distribution of high-luminance spots localized to the remaining proximal base of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe structural amputation of the first dorsal fin, featuring a jagged, high-contrast irregular perimeter and exposed internal tissue. Multiple light-colored linear abrasions are visible on the dermal surface posterior to the fin base.
